notes.title: Chapter 2 Released Early | Happy New Year to Everyone!
notes.content:
Thank you for your continuous support and love!

With the outstanding efforts of our team, we are thrilled to announce that Chapter 2 of Arisen Force: Life Devotee has been completed ahead of schedule, concluded its beta testing, and is now officially released.
A brand-new story and adventure, along with new features and fun, are ready to be unveiled to everyone.

If you enjoy this series and would like to support us in creating more exciting works,
you can try our other game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2951840/Arisen_Force_HeroTest]Arisen Force: Hero Test[/url], which is now available at a 21% discount during the Steam Winter Sale!

You can also look forward to our upcoming release,
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2359660/Arisen_Force_Vonimir/]Arisen Force: Vonimir[/url], by adding it to your wishlist and following it~

In addition, the Chapter 2 Original Soundtrack has been released simultaneously. Your support is welcome and greatly appreciated: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3359010/Arisen_Force_Life_Devotee_Soundtrack_II/]Original Soundtrack Chapter 2[/url]

Once again, thank you for your support and love. Wishing everyone a prosperous Year of the Snake, good health for your families, and the fulfillment of all your wishes!

notes.title: 1.0.05 Update| Multi-language support
notes.content:
[list] 
[*] Added multi-language support. ( PS: [i]Due to time and budget constraints, the translation quality may not be perfect. We hope for your understanding.[/i]）
[*] Lampwick Ring: Players who have defeated Red Boy can directly obtain it in the 6th stage. 
[*] Fine-tuned the perfect timing range for "Disrupt" (Counter Move). 
[*] Increased invincibility frames and the Burning Blade value for perfect counterattacks with the "Dagger" weapon type. 
[*] Optimized running cancel. 
[*] Optimized some levels return points. 
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.04 Update Notes
notes.content:

[*] Adjusted Skill: Slash Stick, unlocks charging stages based on level.
[*] Reduced the skill multiplier for Boss Ren Shen Jing.
[*] Nerfed the grab detection for Boss Yu Long Wang.
[*] Adjusted some air walls.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Difficulty
notes.content:
We truly appreciate everyone who has tried out the game.

Due to a tight development schedule, some issues have arisen in the current version. We’ve noticed that the early game difficulty is too high, so we’ve adjusted enemy stats to smooth the difficulty curve at the start. These changes will be implemented in the next patch.

In addition, we’re working hard to fix other known bugs to deliver a better experience as soon as possible.
